test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.**

Overflow or fill an area with excess water, as in a flood
solution: The correct answer is '**Inundate**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Inundate**'. • Inundate: to cover an area of land with water. ज़मीन का पानी से ढक जाना, बाढ़ आ जाना • *Example: After the heavy rains the fields were **inundated**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Inundate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Storm**: An extreme weather condition with strong winds and heavy rain or snow ( आंधी) • **Cover**: to put something on or in front of something to hide or protect it. छिपाने या बचाने के लिए ढकना • **Supersede**: to take the place of somebody/something which existed or was used before and which has become old-fashioned. पूर्व में विद्यमान या प्रयोग में आ रही वस्‍तु को हटाकर उसका स्‍थान ले लेना; अधिक्रमण करना 30:Tfea, The erroneous part is** 'will have time'.**
